description: Saves a new diagram from a DSP scene or Mermaid text; returns its id, revision 1 and hashes. key is your stable name for it, unique in the workspace: your repeat with the same key and content returns the existing diagram, not a copy. brief stores context for the next agent. Versions are kept until you delete the diagram or its workspace is deleted.

brief.description: What the diagram shows, conventions to keep, decisions made

mermaid.description: erDiagram or flowchart (graph); drops subgraphs, edges to them and styles

message.description: One line on why it was made

name: diagram_create
title: Save a diagram
